<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="twin-furies-boss-guide" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Twin Furies – Boss Guide</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/gaIHwzHbTa.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="general-information"><ins><nowiki>General Information</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The Twin Furies are located in the Heart of Gielinor.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The duo consists of </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Nymora</nowiki></strong><nowiki> in the East and </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Avaryss</nowiki></strong><nowiki> in the West.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Entering the encounter requires 40 kill count, or 20 kill count with enough reputation.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Level 80 Ranged </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is required to create an instance, which you can boost with any ranged potion / overload </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689554436179361864.png?v=1" alt="overload" title="overload" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The Twin Furies share one health pool of 200,000 LP.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In Hard Mode, the fight adds lava bombs alongside the standard mechanics.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Other guides: </nowiki><span><nowiki>#twin-furies-gwd2</nowiki></span><nowiki> </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki> </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="gear-relics-and-familiars"><ins><nowiki>Gear, Relics and Familiars</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The following presets are based on Stage 1 </nowiki><span><nowiki>#upgrade-order</nowiki></span><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=36ec3ebe-379d-4350-a3ff-ce7a88f7525a <nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/0cc0865639e485caeb034ef48e2806552c432364318e5947e42bbda880dd992c.webp" alt="Stage 1 - Magic Gear" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=50e03e24-37ad-4be8-abf5-a4bb22c0aa09 <nowiki>Ranged</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/d847e477c9dee750671dc663d939622012cd335757c2e454725cb7b72f3489be.webp" alt="Stage 1 - Ranged Gear" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=de7d0a00-3300-4607-ad6f-0c98f839c560 <nowiki>Melee</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/bf9d237f97d7548ffb0120ce1364f58961d674eb3aaf2da5c5e5d9505b8b0fc5.webp" alt="Stage 1 - Melee Gear" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=0d30907b-8f74-4b10-9335-335d98008918 <nowiki>Necromancy</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>​
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F0d30907b-8f74-4b10-9335-335d98008918.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="fight-mechanics"><ins><nowiki>Fight Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Poison </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1" alt="poisonicon" title="poisonicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> splats may appear, but they do </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> deal damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="attack-rotation"><ins><nowiki>Attack Rotation</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ Normal Mode: </nowiki><em><nowiki>Avaryss' Surge</nowiki></em><nowiki> → auto attacks → </nowiki><em><nowiki>Rain Death</nowiki></em><nowiki> → auto attacks → </nowiki><em><nowiki>Burn Phase</nowiki></em><nowiki> → auto attacks → Repeat</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ Hard Mode: 2 auto attacks → </nowiki><em><nowiki>Avaryss' Surge + Lava Bombs</nowiki></em><nowiki> → auto attacks → </nowiki><em><nowiki>Ceiling Collapse + Lava Bombs</nowiki></em><nowiki> → auto attacks → </nowiki><em><nowiki>Channeled Bomb + Lava Bombs</nowiki></em><nowiki> → auto attacks → </nowiki><em><nowiki>Blue Lava Bomb + Lava Bombs</nowiki></em><nowiki> → auto attacks → Repeat</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="shared-health-pool"><ins><nowiki>Shared Health Pool</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Avaryss and Nymora share one health pool</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ When they are close together, AoE abilities can hit both twins and effectively damage the shared health pool twice</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Hit caps do </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> apply to the Twin Furies' health pool, so some high-damage hits may deal more damage than the visible hitsplats suggest</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use AoE abilities when both twins are close together e.g., </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306391265284.png?v=1" alt="bombard" title="bombard" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1" alt="spectralscythe" title="spectralscythe" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1" alt="gchain" title="gchain" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ High-damage combinations such as Chaos Roar </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644356671737966.png?v=1" alt="chaosroar" title="chaosroar" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → Overpower </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1" alt="overpowerigneous" title="overpowerigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will also go through the hit cap</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="avaryss-surge-example"><ins><nowiki>Avaryss' Surge</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/NWTHSDg.mp4 <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Avaryss jumps to a wall, then charges across the arena</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This repeats 4 times</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Avaryss always travels in cardinal directions, such as north to south or west to east</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In Hard Mode, the dive can hit up to around 4,000 Melee damage, stun for 3 seconds, and disable overhead prayers</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In Hard Mode, attacking Avaryss mid-jump can reflect 90% of the damage taken</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Move out of Avaryss' path after she jumps to a new wall</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In Hard Mode, continually move to avoid being pushed and stunned</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Avoid attacking Avaryss mid-jump in Hard Mode</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="ceiling-collapse-example"><ins><nowiki>Ceiling Collapse</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/QIMa9WS.mp4 <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Nymora jumps to a random square and causes a ceiling collapse</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In Hard Mode, Nymora yells &quot;we will purge them all!&quot; before the collapse</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In Hard Mode, this deals rapid Ranged damage up to around 1,000 damage every 1.8 seconds</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Stand in the 3x3 area around Nymora to negate the mechanic</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use defensive abilities if needed while moving into position</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="channeled-bomb-examples-explosion"><ins><nowiki>Channeled Bomb</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/N7ceSRh.mp4 <nowiki>(Examples)</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/CJkO32O.mp4 <nowiki>(Explosion)</nowiki>]</h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The twins move to the centre of the arena and channel an attack</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If the channel finishes, it deals 4,500 damage in Normal Mode</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In Hard Mode, this can deal up to around 8,000 damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ During this mechanic, the twins take 2x damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You take typeless damage during the channel, which can be offset by Soul Split </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use AoE abilities while the twins are close together</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Melee can use Cleave </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878616985610.png?v=1" alt="cleave" title="cleave" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Hurricane </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Quake </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1" alt="quake" title="quake" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Necromancy can use Spectral Scythe </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1" alt="spectralscythe" title="spectralscythe" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Spectral Scythe II </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809149690916945.png?v=1" alt="spectralscythe2" title="spectralscythe2" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Spectral Scythe III </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809152043925505.png?v=1" alt="spectralscythe3" title="spectralscythe3" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Move or Surge </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to the edge of the arena before the explosion </nowiki><strong><nowiki>or</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Block the explosion with defensive abilities</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="lava-bombs-hm-only"><ins><nowiki>Lava Bombs (HM Only)</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ A lava bomb spawns alongside each main mechanic</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Lava bombs bounce around the arena 5 times before disappearing</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Green arrows show where the lava bomb will land</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If you are within the 5x5 landing area, you take 3,000-4,000 hard typeless damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ After 2 bounces, a second lava bomb spawns</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Watch the green arrows and move away from the landing area</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Keep moving while handling the main mechanic</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Avoid pathing into Avaryss' jump path while dodging lava bombs</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="blue-lava-bomb-hm-only"><ins><nowiki>Blue Lava Bomb (HM Only)</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ A blue lava bomb bounces around the arena 3 times</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Green arrows show where the blue lava bomb will land</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If avoided, it homes in on the player and deals 6,000-7,000 hard typeless damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If the player takes the bomb, it also hits both twins for the same damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Intentionally take the blue lava bomb to damage both twins</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Prepare defensives or healing before taking the hit</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Avoid overlapping the blue bomb with other dangerous mechanics where possible</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="videos"><ins><nowiki>Videos</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
